delicious food
Aug 2026 • Friends
Solid Thai spot! We got the pad thai, seafood som tum, stir-fried okra and tom yum, everything came out fresh and well-balanced. The pad thai had generous shrimp, squid and tofu with crunchy bean sprouts and peanuts on the side, and the som tum was loaded with clams, prawns and squid over rice noodles. The creamy tom yum was rich but still nice and sour. Portions are big enough to share. Would come back!
